chain.limits: The sample is the first 24 named objects of each of six registers, and the perturbations are four declared settings, so the figures are about this sample and this sweep. A wrong answer is reported separately from a refusal and is never folded into an accuracy.
chain.method: Every carrier of the declared sample is indexed at all 12 rungs; a query is the carrier with a deterministic offset added; a rung answers only when its cell holds exactly one carrier; the three orders differ only in which rung is tried first.

retirement.rule: retire a rung that answers any query wrongly, and retire a rung with unique_correct = 0 that takes part in a disagreement

safety.statement: a reading is safe when every query it does not answer correctly is refused rather than answered wrongly

completeness.why_interleaving_is_needed: doubling multiplies squared norms by four, so one construction scaled by powers of two lands on every other power of two; the family is complete only because the Z/D/A/B/C-type rungs are interleaved with the scalings

scaling_rule.consequence: a single construction scaled by powers of two visits the norms m, 4m, 16m, ... -- one residue class of the powers of two -- so a complete power-of-two family needs the Z/D/A-type rungs interleaved with the scalings
